body.summary: A German Netflix series set in the fictional small town of Winden, where the disappearance of children in 2019 leads four interlinked families into a time-travel conspiracy. A cave beneath the nuclear power plant hides a passage that moves people 33 years between 1953, 1986 and 2019, and the plot reveals that the missing boy Mikkel became Jonas's father Michael. Seasons 2 and 3 expand the loop into a war between Adam and Eva over two mirrored worlds, until ||Claudia sends Jonas and Martha into the origin world to stop the clockmaker Tannhaus from splitting reality, erasing both worlds and leaving only the origin world, where Regina lives.||

notable_scenes.summary: Mikkel vanishes in the cave and wakes in 1986, where a young Hannah finds him in the hospital.
Michael's suicide letter reveals that Mikkel became Michael and that Jonas is his son.
The older Jonas locks his younger self in the bunker and explains they are the same person.
The apocalypse hits Winden on June 27, 2020, and the screen whites out.
Martha from the mirror world arrives in 1888 and tells Jonas she is not his Martha.
Jonas and Martha travel to the origin world and stop the Tannhaus family at the bridge, erasing both worlds.
